text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Oh my, it's almost time for training. I'd better turn off the TV…

text_block_list.name: TV Show Host
text_block_list.text: "All right! Let's get the real scoop on how this year's world champion won it all!"

text_block_list.name: TV Show Host
text_block_list.text: "First off, what would you say was the key to your victory?"

text_block_list.name: Professional Athlete
text_block_list.text: "Well, I would always imagine myself standing at the top of the world to keep myself motivated, but aside from that…"

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Haha! One day, I'll be the one responding to interviews like that!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Hm, showing everyone the possible paths they can take is also an important mission of mine…

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: And in that case… I guess it wouldn't hurt to watch a little more of this program.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: It'll be good reference for how I should handle my future interviews! I'll just train more to make up for the time I miss!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Seeking the Pearl continues watching the show and completely misses her training session.
